import html # Example template – in real use this would come from a config or file html_template = """ User Page

Welcome!

{user_content}
""" def build_html_page(client_input: str) -> str: """ Construct an HTML page by safely embedding user-provided content into a predefined template. Parameters: client_input (str): The raw string supplied by the user that will be inserted into the HTML response. Returns: str: The complete HTML page with the user content safely escaped. """ # Escape all characters that have special meaning in HTML to prevent # injection attacks (e.g., <, >, &, ", '). safe_content = html.escape(client_input, quote=True) # Insert the escaped content into the template. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
